messages:
amanda: Hey team — planning to spin up release/v1.14.0 today. Quick Qs: who has perms to create release/* branches in repo redwood/runtime? Also reminder: version bump + changelog cutoff is EOD PT. Can someone volunteer to collect final changelog entries? cc @tim @sahil

tim: I can create the branch if I get a thumbs from release lead. What's the exact branch name? release/v1.14.0 or release/1.14?

amanda: release/v1.14.0 — we want semantic tagging. Also need confirmation on backport policy: only critical bugfixes after cutoff, everything else goes to next minor.

sahil: confirming backport policy — agreed. Please add backport requests to the backport board and tag with `release-1.14`.

jess: Changelog finalization — I'll collate PR descriptions. Can folks drop a one-line entry in the changelog PR (#2390) by 4pm PT? I'll shepherd.

release-bot: CI reminder — branch protection requires 1 approved review and green CI before push.

tim: I have perms. Will create branch once @maria (release lead) gives go. Command I'll run: ```
git checkout -b release/v1.14.0
git push origin release/v1.14.0
```

maria: Go for it. Also reminder: no feature merges after cutoff; only bugfix cherry-picks with the `release-blocker` label.

amanda: thanks. @tim please add the branch to the release board and tag it with `release/1.14-created`. @jess — once you post changelog I'll do a quick skim for missing highlights.

sahil: pinging infra for backport access if needed @infra-team — do we need any additional perms for cherry-pick merges into the release branch?

infra-team: infra-team: you should be fine; ops will grant temporary write to the release branch if needed. File a ticket if you hit a 403.

tim: branch created and pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/branches/release/v1.14.0 :thumbsup:

jess: Changelog PR is up at https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2390 — please add a one-line note (what changed + PR link). Deadline 4pm PT.

amanda: Great. We'll run a staging smoke at 6pm PT. If any regressions, open a PR with `release-blocker` and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks everyone!
